title: Renaming a category keeps it on the same matrix
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, on matrix A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one range from $0.00 and Default on Markup % 50, pricing category A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Click the category name at the top of the page.
  4. Type a new name no other category uses.
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Open Settings › Categories.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed on matrix A.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name becomes editable.

Step 4:

  • The new name shows in the field.

Step 5:

  • The title shows the new name.

Step 6:

  • The category is listed under its new name.
  • Its Pricing Matrix cell still reads matrix A.
